meta.name: apple-calendar-macos
meta.description: Use local CLI to manage Apple, Google, iCloud, Outlook, CalDAV, and other calendars synced in macOS Calendar, without API keys or OAuth.

copy.tagline: 管理macOS日历中同步的各类日历，无需API密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在macOS上管理多个日历账户
copy.tagline_en: Manage calendars synced in macOS Calendar without API keys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple calendar accounts on macOS

howto.what: Claude 能通过本地命令管理 macOS 日历中已同步的各类日历（Apple、Google、iCloud 等），无需 API 密钥或 OAuth。可执行查找、创建、修改、删除、冲突检查并在写入后验证结果。
howto.when: 当用户想要管理本地 macOS 日历应用中已同步的事件时触发。要求 macOS 系统且至少有一个命令行工具（如 apple-calendar-cli）可用。

say.text: 帮我把下周二下午3点的会议改到4点。
say.note: Claude 会先读取该时段事件，修改后验证。

say.text: 在工作日历上新建一个明天上午10点的提醒。
say.note: Claude 会创建事件并确认结果。

say.text: 删除本周五下午6点的晚餐事件。

howto.what_en: Claude can manage all calendars synced in macOS Calendar (Apple, Google, iCloud, etc.) via local commands, without API keys or OAuth. It can look up, create, update, delete events, check conflicts, and verify after writes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to manage events from the macOS Calendar stack where Google, iCloud, Exchange, and CalDAV accounts are already synced locally. Requires macOS and at least one available CLI tool (e.g., apple-calendar-cli).

say_en.text: Move my meeting next Tuesday to 4 PM.
say_en.note: Claude reads the window first, then updates and verifies.

say_en.text: Create a reminder at 10 AM tomorrow on my work calendar.
say_en.note: Creates the event and confirms the result.

say_en.text: Delete the dinner event this Friday at 6 PM.
